description: The Spatial Finance Initiative publishes an archived July 2021 Excel snapshot of global cement production assets. Zenodo lists the workbook under CC BY 4.0. Its description reports 3,117 operating plants with geolocation and, where available, ownership, production process, capacity and production-start year. This historical inventory can seed plant exposure and capacity scenarios or provide a baseline against the later SFI supplier-linked release. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this named 2021 snapshot. Coverage is the plants represented in the archived compilation, not all possible small cement producers or later closures. A limitation is that location and ownership are copied from a compiled database and the public summary does not state field-by-field confidence or missingness. Capacity does not measure actual output. The newer supplier release has a different structure and date; these records are therefore distinct snapshots, not two copies of the same file. The workbook was not downloaded or its plant count recalculated.
